items.source: Create an instance from a collection of UriComponentsContributors or HandlerMethodArgumentResolvers.
items.translation: 从一组 UriComponentsContributors 或 HandlerMethodArgumentResolvers 创建实例。

items.source: contributors - a collection of UriComponentsContributor or HandlerMethodArgumentResolvers
items.translation: contributors - 一个包含UriComponentsContributor或HandlerMethodArgumentResolvers的集合

items.source: Create an instance from a collection of UriComponentsContributors or HandlerMethodArgumentResolvers. Since both of these tend to be implemented by the same class, the most convenient option is to obtain the configured HandlerMethodArgumentResolvers in RequestMappingHandlerAdapter and provide that to this constructor.
items.translation: 从一组UriComponentsContributors或HandlerMethodArgumentResolvers创建实例。由于这两者通常由同一类实现，最方便的选择是在RequestMappingHandlerAdapter中获取配置的HandlerMethodArgumentResolvers并将其提供给该构造函数。

items.source: If the ConversionService argument is null, DefaultFormattingConversionService will be used by default.
items.translation: 如果 `ConversionService` 参数为 `null`，则默认将使用 `DefaultFormattingConversionService`。

items.source: A UriComponentsContributor containing a list of other contributors to delegate to and also encapsulating a specific ConversionService to use for formatting method argument values as Strings.
items.translation: 包含一个其他贡献者列表以供委托，并封装特定ConversionService以用于将方法参数值格式化为字符串的UriComponentsContributor。

items.source: Description copied from interface: UriComponentsContributor
items.translation: 描述从接口复制：UriComponentsContributor

items.source: Description copied from interface: UriComponentsContributor
items.translation: 描述从接口复制：UriComponentsContributor

items.source: Process the given method argument and either update the UriComponentsBuilder or add to the map with URI variables to use to expand the URI after all arguments are processed.
items.translation: 处理给定的方法参数，要么更新UriComponentsBuilder，要么将其添加到用于在全部参数处理后扩展 URI 的 URI 变量映射中。

items.source: Determine if this CompositeUriComponentsContributor has any contributors.
items.translation: 确定此 `CompositeUriComponentsContributor` 是否包含任何贡献者。

items.source: An overloaded method that uses the ConversionService created at construction.
items.translation: 一个在构造时创建 ConversionService 的重载方法。

items.source: Whether this contributor supports the given method parameter.
items.translation: 该贡献者是否支持给定的方法参数。

items.source: supportsParameter in interface UriComponentsContributor
items.translation: `UriComponentsContributor` 接口中的 supportsParameter

items.source: contributeMethodArgument in interface UriComponentsContributor
items.translation: `UriComponentsContributor` 接口中的 contributeMethodArgument

items.source: true if this CompositeUriComponentsContributor was created with contributors to delegate to
items.translation: 如果此 CompositeUriComponentsContributor 是在创建时指定了要委托的贡献者，则返回 true。

items.source: cs - a ConversionService to use when method argument values need to be formatted as Strings before being added to the URI
items.translation: cs - 在将方法参数值格式化为字符串并添加到 URI 之前，用于使用的转换服务 (ConversionService)。

items.source: parameter - the controller method parameter (never null)
items.translation: parameter - 控制器方法参数（永远不为 null）

items.source: value - the argument value (possibly null)
items.translation: value - 参数值（可能为 null）

items.source: builder - the builder to update (never null)
items.translation: builder - 要更新的构建器（永远不为 null）

items.source: uriVariables - a map to add URI variables to (never null)
items.translation: uriVariables - 用于添加 URI 变量的映射（永远不为 null）

items.source: conversionService - a ConversionService to format values as Strings
items.translation: conversionService - 用于将值格式化为字符串的 ConversionService。
